name: The Spirit Of Religion
overview: The Spirit of Religion, as revealed in Scripture, centers on the active presence and work of the Holy Spirit in the life of the believer. Isaiah 61:1 highlights the Spirit's anointing to proclaim liberty and healing, while Jesus promises the Holy Spirit as the Comforter who teaches and reminds believers of His truth (John 14:26). Romans 8 emphasizes that those indwelt and led by the Spirit of God are truly God’s children, marked by a spiritual relationship distinct from the flesh (Romans 8:9, 14, 16). The Great Commission (Matthew 28:19) underscores the Spirit’s role in making disciples through baptism and teaching, affirming the Spirit’s essential role in the ongoing mission of the church.
